title: Pet Abandonment Cases Investigates and Prosecuted in Past Five Years
what_it_is: Pet Abandonment Cases Investigates and Prosecuted in Past Five Years

sections.label: Pet abandonment case outcomes
sections.summary: Of the cases, 11 got composition fines, 21 were fined in Court, one jailed, and about half involved cats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Of these cases, 11 persons were issued composition fines, 21 persons were sentenced in Court and fined, and one was given a jail term.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: About half the cases investigated, and half the cases for which further action was taken, involved cats.

sections.label: Penalties for pet abandonment
sections.summary: First-time offenders face a maximum $10,000 fine, up to 12 months' jail, or both, and penalties will be reviewed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: First-time offenders can face a maximum fine of $10,000, or a jail term of up to 12 months, or both.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: We will continue to review the penalties under the Act to ensure that they remain effective in deterring acts of pet abandonment.

sections.label: Review of pet sector
sections.summary: A comprehensive pet sector review involves stakeholders and will consider micro-chipping of cats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: As the Member would be aware, we have started a comprehensive review of the pet sector, involving various stakeholders, looking at training regimes or trainers, looking at rehabilitation, adoption, routines and practices with the animal welfare groups, engaging breeders and boarders, and also individual pet owners.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: The Member had asked about the micro-chipping of cats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: This will also be taken into consideration as we review the pet sector.

sections.label: Reviewing Animals and Birds Act
sections.summary: The review also covers the Animals and Birds Act and penalty frameworks, with results hoped for this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: As part of this review, we are also reviewing the Animals and Birds Act and we are also looking at the kind of penalty frameworks that are in place.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: So, certainly, this is one area that we will consider as part of the review and we hope to do so in the coming months and, hopefully, by this year.
